and have more energy.

If brushing hasn’t worked for your dog,

body.text:
Watch what coconut oil actually does to dog tartar.
You’ve tried this one, right?
Rub it on the gums. Let the lauric acid “dissolve” buildup.

Here’s the problem.

Tartar is calcified.
It’s hardened calcium phosphate.

Coconut oil can’t break that down.

It just gets licked off in 30 seconds.

Myth number two: dental chews remove tartar.

They don’t.

They touch the outer surface your dog can chew.

They don’t reach between teeth.
They don’t reach under the gumline.

And that’s where the infection actually starts.

So the smell comes back.
The yellow gets darker.

It’s not you.

The product was never designed to fix the root cause.

Myth number three: raw bones are “nature’s toothbrush.”

Bones are harder than your dog’s teeth.

I’ve seen fractured molars every single week from this advice.

And even when teeth don’t break?

Bones still can’t dissolve calcified tartar.
They can’t reach under the gums.

So what actually works?

Something systemic.

DentaClean was developed to work from the inside out.

You spray it on food.
Probiotics help support the gum barrier.
Brown algae helps break down the calcium bonds holding tartar in place.

It reaches areas chews, oil, and bones never can.

In weeks, fresher breath.
In months, visibly healthier gums.

If you’ve been cycling through hacks and nothing sticks —

You’re not failing your dog.

You were just sold myths.

Tap below to try something that actually addresses the cause.

Before the next cleaning becomes unavoidable.
